story.title: Meta

story.text: screenshot of five hardest problems in DevOps today.
1. Coping with continuous change & complexity
2. Coordination and synchronization of work at speed and scale
3. Communicating with other real actual human beings when non-collocated
4. Managing tradeoff decisions and production pressure.
5. Establishing, maintaining, & repairing common ground in both formal and informal teams. [https://youtu.be/n3DvKmqhzUo?t=7976 7976s]
